01安全与地缘 / 油轮 · 2026年11月9日

霍尔木兹遭遇“火周末”：美军轰炸散货船，两艘油轮同晚遇袭

Hormuz Suffers Weekend of Fire as US Bombs Bulker and Two Tankers Are Hit in One Evening

Merchant shipping was caught in a sharp escalation around the Strait of Hormuz over 72 hours. On Saturday a US aircraft fired precision-guided munitions at the stern of the St Kitts and Nevis-flagged bulk carrier Huda in the Gulf of Oman after it ignored warnings while leaving regional waters following a visit to an Iranian port, in violation of Washington's naval blockade; the crew had been told to leave the targeted areas and the vessel was disabled. Two tankers were hit within an hour on Saturday evening: at about 19:20 UTC a tanker caught fire eight nautical miles northwest of Khasab, Oman, and its crew was evacuated, and an hour later another outbound tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile, with all crew safe and no environmental damage. On Sunday the UAE National Guard rescued 22 Arab seafarers from a burning cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman. Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy claimed two tankers had struck naval mines on unauthorised routes, and the semi-official Fars news agency reported a third tanker exploding and catching fire, though the claims have not been independently verified. According to BRS Shipbrokers, 141 tankers are now dedicated to shuttling crude and products from Gulf terminals to the Gulf of Oman or India's west coast, with VLCCs accounting for 72%, crude lifted inside the Gulf trading at discounts of up to $45 per barrel against Gulf of Oman delivery, and only 639 VLCCs, or 68% of active tonnage, effectively available for mainstream business.

过去72小时霍尔木兹周边局势急剧升级。周六，美军飞机向圣基茨和尼维斯籍散货船 Huda 船尾发射精确制导弹药，原因是该船在访问伊朗港口后无视警告试图离境，违反美国海上封锁；船员已按指令撤离目标区域，船只被击伤失去动力。周六晚两艘油轮一小时内先后遇袭：约19:20 UTC，一艘油轮在阿曼哈萨卜西北8海里处起火、船员撤离；一小时后另一艘出港油轮被不明抛射物击中，船员安全、无环境损害。周日，阿联酋国民警卫队从阿曼湾一艘起火货船上救出22名阿拉伯海员。伊朗革命卫队海军随后声称两艘油轮在“未经授权航线”上触雷，半官方的法尔斯通讯社还报道第三艘油轮爆炸起火，但这些说法未经独立证实。另据BRS Shipbrokers统计，现已有141艘油轮专做海湾至阿曼湾或印度西海岸的穿梭运输，其中VLCC占72%，海湾内装货原油相对阿曼湾交付价折价高达每桶45美元，主流市场实际可用VLCC仅剩639艘、约占现役运力的68%。

伊朗称霍尔木兹南部助航设施被毁，夜间无“未经授权”船只通过

Iran Says No Unauthorised Vessels Transited Hormuz Overnight After Navigation Aids Destroyed

An unnamed Revolutionary Guards Navy official told Iranian state media on Monday that navigational aid systems in the south of the Strait of Hormuz had been destroyed and that no unauthorised vessels transited the route overnight. The claim has not been independently verified, and it follows Iranian claims on Sunday that three tankers struck mines on an unauthorised route, underscoring that the strait's southern lanes have become the focus of control and risk.

伊朗革命卫队海军一名未具名官员周一对伊朗官方媒体表示，霍尔木兹海峡南部航行辅助系统已被摧毁，夜间没有未经授权的船只通过该航道。该说法未获独立证实，与周日伊朗方面称三艘油轮在“未经授权航线”上触雷起火的说法相互关联，凸显海峡南侧航道正成为管控与风险焦点。

特朗普将会见调停人卡塔尔首相，但各方认为短期内难达成停战协议

Trump to Meet Qatar, Mediator in Iran War, With No Imminent Deal Seen to End the War

US President Donald Trump will meet Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani in Washington on Monday after the mediator visited Tehran last week. Iran's proposal would end its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz in return for an end to the US blockade of its ports, the lifting of some sanctions and a halt to bombing, but Washington has repeatedly rejected it, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling Tehran's conditions "outrageous and ridiculous". Senior US and Gulf officials cast doubt on an imminent deal while mutual attacks continue.

美国总统特朗普将于周一在白宫会见卡塔尔首相兼外交大臣谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼，后者上周刚访问德黑兰。伊朗的方案是：以停止封锁霍尔木兹海峡换取美国结束港口封锁、解除部分制裁并停止轰炸，但美方多次拒绝该方案，国务卿鲁比奥周日称伊方条件“离谱、不现实”。美方官员与海湾官员均认为短期内难有突破，同时相互袭击仍在继续。

04安全与地缘 / 海事保险 · 2026年11月9日

黑海航运再遭周末袭击，战争险保费高达船值的20%

Black Sea Shipping Reels From Fresh Attacks and Record Insurance Costs

The Black Sea endured another violent weekend, with Russia claiming fresh strikes on merchant vessels carrying military supplies for Ukraine, including a dry cargo ship near Odesa and a containership at Chornomorsk, though none of the claims has been independently verified and the ships have not been identified. Bulgarian prosecutors said on Saturday that human remains were found aboard the San Marino-flagged chemical tanker Wine Trader, damaged in a drone strike off Romania on October 15 and brought into Varna for repairs; local television reported the remains of six seafarers, with DNA testing ordered, after seven of the ship's 12 crew went missing and five were rescued. War-risk premiums for particularly exposed Black Sea voyages have reached as much as 20% of hull value, exceeding levels seen during the 1980s Iran-Iraq tanker war, while CMA CGM introduced a $35 per teu war-risk surcharge on Black Sea shipments covering Constanta, Varna, Burgas and Poti.

黑海又度过一个暴力周末，俄罗斯国防部周末接连宣称袭击了运载援乌军用物资的商船，包括敖德萨附近的干货船和乔尔诺莫斯克的集装箱船，但这些说法均未获独立证实，涉事船舶也未被确认。保加利亚检方周六宣布，在10月15日遭无人机袭击后拖入瓦尔纳维修的圣马力诺籍化学品船 Wine Trader 上发现了遇难海员遗体，当地电视台称发现六名海员遗体，检方已下令DNA检测确认身份；该船12名船员中7人失踪、5人获救。黑海部分高风险航次的战争险保费已高达船值的20%，超过上世纪80年代两伊油轮战争时期约7.5%–10%的水平；达飞轮船同日起对黑海国家货运加收每标箱35美元战争险附加费，覆盖康斯坦察、瓦尔纳、布尔加斯和波季等港口。

05安全与地缘 / 港口与法规 · 2026年11月9日

法国发起 G7+ 港口联盟，联手14个港口打击毒品海上贩运

France Launches G7+ Ports Alliance to Target Global Narcotics Routes

France formally launched a new G7-backed network on 9 November, during a meeting of G7 foreign ministers in Paris, linking 14 major ports with customs services and international organisations to improve intelligence sharing and coordination against global drug-trafficking routes. The network brings together the G7 countries, Brazil, South Korea and organisations including Interpol, the UN Office on Drugs and Crime, the International Maritime Organization and the World Customs Organization, aiming to improve detection of containers used by criminal organisations.

法国11月9日在巴黎七国集团外长会议期间正式发起 G7 支持的港口网络，覆盖14个港口，联合 G7 国家、巴西、韩国及国际刑警组织、联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室、国际海事组织和世界海关组织等机构，旨在加强港口与海关之间的情报共享与行动协作，识别贩毒路线并提升对被犯罪组织利用的集装箱的查获能力。

油价周一收盘大跌逾5%，布伦特收于92.57美元

Oil Falls Sharply at Monday's Close as Trump Signals Restraint on Iran

Brent crude settled down $5.75, or 5.85%, at $92.57 a barrel on Monday, while WTI settled down $3.98, or 4.38%, at $86.85, both at their lowest since late August, with losses deepening after settlement. Traders unwound war-risk premiums as President Trump played down the likelihood of renewed strikes on Iran and Qatar's prime minister carried an Iranian proposal to the White House. A Reuters survey also found OPEC output rose in October, led by Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Iraq.

布伦特原油周一收跌5.75美元（-5.85%）至92.57美元/桶，WTI收跌3.98美元（-4.38%）至86.85美元/桶，均为8月底以来最低，收盘后跌幅进一步扩大。市场正在消化美伊缓和信号与卡塔尔首相携伊朗方案赴白宫的消息，战争风险溢价快速回落。路透调查还显示，10月欧佩克产量上升，主要来自沙特、科威特和伊拉克。

07能源市场 / 地缘政治（专栏分析） · 2026年11月9日

路透专栏：中东产油国打价格战，霍尔木兹流量恢复预示冲突后供应过剩

Middle East Oil Price War Heralds Post-Conflict Glut (Reuters column)

Middle East producers are cutting prices to attract buyers as a sharp recovery in flows through the Strait of Hormuz tips the global crude market towards oversupply, this Reuters column argues. Crude exports through the strait averaged 10.3 million barrels per day in October, up from virtually zero in the first month of the war, as Gulf producers can now transit in US Navy-protected tanker convoys. Attacks on transiting vessels nevertheless continue on a near-daily basis, forcing many producers to rely on costly ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman. (This item is a Reuters opinion column.)

专栏指出，随着霍尔木兹海峡原油流量快速恢复，中东产油国正下调价格争夺买家，全球原油市场正转向供应过剩。10月经霍尔木兹的原油出口平均为1030万桶/日，已从战争首月的几乎为零大幅回升，原因是海湾产油国可在美国海军护航的油轮编队下通过该水道。但针对过境船只的袭击仍近乎每天发生，许多产油国仍依赖阿曼湾昂贵的船对船过驳。（本条为路透专栏分析，属观点内容。）

Murphy Oil 首入以色列海上天然气勘探，获利维坦西南 G 区六张许可

Murphy Oil Bets on Israeli Gas Near Leviathan

Israel's Energy Ministry awarded six offshore natural gas exploration licences for Zone G to Houston-based Murphy Oil and Israel's Ratio Energies on 9 November. The licences cover about 1,700 sq km of seabed roughly 25 km southwest of the Leviathan gas field, with each partner holding 50% and Murphy as operator. It is Murphy's first venture into the Eastern Mediterranean and Israeli waters. The partners have 36 months to drill an exploration well; Murphy replaces Italy's Eni, which withdrew after winning the block in 2023.

以色列能源部11月9日向美国 Murphy Oil 与以色列 Ratio Energies 授予六张海上天然气勘探许可，覆盖利维坦气田西南约25公里、面积约1,700平方公里的 G 区，双方各持50%权益，Murphy 任作业者。这是 Murphy 首次进入东地中海，也是其首次在以色列水域作业。两家公司须在36个月内钻探一口勘探井；该区块原由 Eni 等持有，Eni 后退出。

LLOG 在美湾增至两座钻井平台，推进 Who Dat 扩建

LLOG Ramps Up US Gulf Activity with Second Rig, Who Dat Expansion Plans

Harbour Energy subsidiary LLOG now has two drilling rigs operating in the US Gulf, with the second arriving in September, and the Kingsroad exploration well is set to spud around year-end 2026. The one-well Who Dat East subsea development was approved in August, with production to flow through a new 29-km pipeline to the Who Dat floating production system, starting up in H2 2028 at about 6,500 bbl/d of liquids and 50 MMcf/d of gas. A final investment decision on the Salamanca floating production system subsea pump project is expected in the next few weeks.

Harbour Energy 子公司 LLOG 在美国墨西哥湾已有两座钻井平台作业，第二座于9月到位；Kingsroad 勘探井计划2026年底前后开钻。Who Dat East 单井海底开发已于8月获批，油气将经29公里新管道输往 Who Dat 浮式生产装置，预计2028年下半年投产，初期产量约6,500桶/日液体与5,000万立方英尺/日天然气。Salamanca 浮式生产系统海底泵项目预计未来数周内作出最终投资决定。

10能源与油气 / 海工 · 2026年11月9日

中石化授出渤海湾涠洲油田扩建海上平台与管道合同

Sinopec Awards Offshore Platform and Pipeline Contract in China

Chinese energy giant Sinopec has awarded an engineering, procurement and construction contract for the Weizhou oilfield expansion in the Beibu Gulf, involving a new offshore processing platform, subsea pipelines, and fibre-optic cables. The contract was awarded to a consortium comprising Sinopec Petroleum Engineering Design and Sinopec Shengli Oil Construction. The package covers detailed engineering, procurement and fabrication of a new offshore oil and gas processing platform featuring an eight-legged jacket, steel piles, topsides, accommodation facilities, and a well-workover module. The original tender estimated the package at RMB1.04bn ($146m), although the final contract value has not been disclosed. The project forms part of Sinopec's development of new production capacity at the Weizhou field, including a new WZ-CEP central processing platform linked to the existing WZ11-4 CEPD installation. The development involves approximately 26 km of subsea pipeline and a parallel fibre-optic cable of similar length. The new platform is designed to accommodate 28 wells, with 16 wells included in the initial drilling programme.

Notorious Dark Fleet VLCC Ends Colourful Career on Bangladesh's Beaches

One of the world's most notorious dark fleet VLCCs has closed a chapter in its history under its last and final name, Era, at the Chattogram shipbreaking yard. The 2002-built, 333 m crude oil tanker, better known until recently as Marinera and before that Bella 1, had resurfaced under the Comoros flag after another change of identity, with public tracking data showing the destination as Chaguaramas in Trinidad & Tobago; its life has now ended in Bangladesh under its eighth name. Sources say it was sold at a huge discount by the US for $205 per ldt, against GMS's latest report noting tankers fetching $535 per ldt in Bangladesh. Its last registered owner was Global Marketing Systems (GMS), registered in the US and managed by Blue Whale Maritime of Mumbai. Its recent history has been anything but quiet: on June 12, former master Avtandil Kalandadze pleaded guilty in Washington DC to failing to obey a lawful order to heave to a US Coast Guard cutter, having been master of Bella 1 from September to late December 2025, during which the vessel transported around 1.8m barrels of Iranian-origin oil to Asia using sanctions-evasion tactics including AIS dark activity and concealing the vessel's name during ship-to-ship transfers. In December 2025 Bella 1 was intercepted by the US Coast Guard off Venezuela, fled across the Atlantic, and was seized on January 7, 2026 in the North Atlantic, having been renamed Marinera and reflagged to Russia during the chase.

Quarterly newbuilding deliveries will average 1 million teu between 2027 and 2030, peaking at 1.8 million teu in the third quarter of 2028, and cumulative effective supply growth could exceed 50% by the end of the decade if Asia-Europe services return to the Suez Canal, adding about 8% effective capacity. Dutch shortsea container operator A2B-online has ordered two more methanol-capable vessels at China Merchants Industry Weihai Shipyard, doubling its fleet renewal programme to four ships. The latest contract marks a switch to China after the company booked its first two newbuildings at Turkey's Sedef Shipyard in 2023. Singapore, Norway Launch $4 Million Research Call to Decarbonize International Shipping

The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore, the Research Council of Norway and the Singapore Maritime Institute have launched a joint $4 million research grant call to decarbonize international shipping. It covers alternative fuels and bunkering infrastructure, vessel energy efficiency and emissions reduction, and digitalization including voyage optimization, just-in-time arrivals and ship–port data exchange. Singapore partners may receive up to $2.11 million and Norwegian partners up to $2.13 million, for projects of up to four years; applications open on 2 December 2026 and close on 20 January 2027.

Meyer Werft Sets Up Offshore Business to Handle $2.8bn Converter Orderbook

German shipbuilding group Meyer Werft is setting up a dedicated offshore business to manage its growing involvement in North Sea converter platform construction. The new company, Neptun Offshore, will bring together the group's offshore converter activities and hold its 50% stake in Neptun Smulders Offshore Renewables (NSORe), a joint venture with Belgian steel construction specialist Smulders. NSORe secured two major offshore converter contracts from German transmission system operator 50Hertz earlier this year for the LanWin3 and LanWin6 grid connection projects in the North Sea. The joint venture's share of the contracts is valued at approximately €2.5bn ($2.8bn), with a substantial proportion of the work expected to take place in the German state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, including at Neptun Werft's facilities in Rostock. Both projects involve 2GW offshore converter platforms designed to transmit electricity generated by North Sea wind farms to the German power grid. The group aims to have the new structure established ahead of the construction of the first converter platform in 2028, and estimates the two existing contracts could create up to 1,000 direct and indirect jobs in the region.

Offshore drilling contractor Ocean Oilfield has secured a contract from Tende Energy to deploy its Ocean MVM jackup rig for a drilling campaign offshore Tunisia. The Ocean MVM jackup was previously named Noble Resolve and was sold by Noble Corporation to Ocean Oilfield for $64m in cash in December 2025. The planned work involves drilling a deviated sidetrack from the existing Maâmoura E2 well to bring additional hydrocarbons into production through infrastructure already in place. According to technical information published by Anglo Tunisian Oil & Gas, the proposed Abiod well could deliver gross production exceeding 6,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, subject to successful drilling and reservoir performance. The Maâmoura field is located in approximately 58 m of water and forms part of Tende's wider Tunisian offshore portfolio, which also includes the neighbouring Baraka concession. Tende holds a 49% operated interest in Maâmoura, with Tunisia's state-owned ETAP controlling the remaining 51%.

海上钻井承包商 Ocean Oilfield 从 Tende Energy 赢得合同，将部署 Ocean MVM 自升式钻井平台，在突尼斯海上开展钻井作业。该平台将用于哈马马特湾 Maâmoura 特许区的 Abiod 井项目，目标为此前未开发的裂缝碳酸盐岩储层，作业包括从现有 Maâmoura E2 井钻一口斜向侧钻井，利用已有设施增产。据 Anglo Tunisian Oil & Gas 公布的技术资料，拟议的 Abiod 井在钻探成功、储层表现达标的情况下，总产量有望超过6,000桶油当量/日。Maâmoura 油田水深约58米，Tende 持有49%作业权益，突尼斯国有企业 ETAP 持有其余51%。

Boluda 收购荷兰海上拖轮专家 Muller Dordrecht

Boluda Buys Dutch Offshore Towage Specialist

Spanish towage giant Boluda has acquired Dutch offshore towage and heavy transport specialist Muller Dordrecht, adding 16 tugs and eight barges to its growing global fleet. The takeover gives Boluda full ownership of the century-old family business, whose fleet includes seven offshore tugs specialising in complex marine transportation, rig moves, anchor handling and offshore wind projects. Financial terms of the transaction have not been disclosed. Muller, founded in 1918 and headquartered in Dordrecht, will continue operating as an independent unit under the name Boluda Muller Towage, retaining its existing management team and focusing on offshore towage and marine projects worldwide. Former chief executive and owner Bram Muller will remain involved as an adviser, along with the company's advisory board. The Dutch operator has built a sizeable presence in the North Sea and Baltic markets, supporting offshore energy and infrastructure projects ranging from transporting wind turbine foundations and offshore substations to heavy lifting and coastal towage. Its fleet includes the 120-tonne bollard pull En Avant 30 and the 90-tonne bollard pull En Avant 25 and En Avant 26. The takeover marks another step in Boluda's acquisition drive. Last October, the group struck a $640m deal to acquire Boskalis' harbour towage and salvage operations in Australia and Papua New Guinea, expanding its reach to more than 230 ports across five continents. The latest transaction also follows last week's agreement by sister company Boluda Shipping to acquire Dutch multimodal operator Samskip, creating a shortsea network spanning 32 vessels and 18 routes across 28 countries. That deal is expected to close in January 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.

西班牙拖轮巨头 Boluda 收购荷兰海上拖轮与重型运输专家 Muller Dordrecht 的全部股权，为其不断扩大的全球船队增加16艘拖轮和8艘驳船。交易使 Boluda 获得这家百年家族企业的全部所有权，其船队包括7艘专营复杂海上运输、钻井平台移位、锚作与海上风电项目的海上拖轮；交易财务条款未披露。Muller 成立于1918年、总部位于多德雷赫特，将以 Boluda Muller Towage 的名义作为独立单元继续运营，保留现有管理团队，专注全球海上拖轮与海洋工程；前首席执行官兼所有者 Bram Muller 将留任顾问。Boluda 去年10月还以6.4亿美元收购 Boskalis 在澳大利亚和巴布亚新几内亚的港口拖轮与救助业务，业务覆盖五大洲230多个港口；其姊妹公司 Boluda Shipping 上周达成协议收购荷兰多式联运运营商 Samskip，交易预计2027年1月完成，尚待监管批准。

Leon Shipping Makes Dry Bulk Debut with Hengli Order

Greek shipowner Panos Efthimiadis is making his first move into dry bulk shipping, with his Leon Shipping & Trading linked to a kamsarmax newbuilding at China's Hengli Heavy Industries as its orderbook grows to five vessels. The Athens-based company has also been linked to two LR1 product tanker newbuildings, adding to a pair of 50,000 dwt MR tankers recently booked at Cosco Shipping Heavy Industry (Guangdong). The two MR tankers at Cosco, carrying hull numbers 1350 and 1351, are scheduled for delivery in March and August 2029, according to shipbroking records. Both vessels were acquired earlier this year from International Seaways for a combined $32m.

Precious Shipping 换帅：执掌三十余年的 Hashim 交棒

Khalid Hashim Set to Pass the Baton at Precious Shipping

Thailand's Precious Shipping is preparing a change at the top, with longtime managing director Khalid Moinuddin Hashim moving to executive vice chairman and finance chief Gautam Khurana taking over the running of the Bangkok-listed dry bulk owner. The company's board approved the leadership reshuffle, with both appointments taking effect on January 1, 2027, according to a filing with the Stock Exchange of Thailand. Khurana will continue to serve as director of finance until a successor is appointed. Both executives will retain their seats on the company's board of directors and executive board. The transition marks a significant shift for Precious Shipping, which has been led by Hashim for more than three decades. He helped build the company into one of Thailand's most prominent dry bulk owners following its establishment in 1989 and stock market listing in 1993. Khurana joined Precious in 2018 as chief financial officer before becoming finance director in 2019. His earlier career included a decade at DVB Bank in London and Singapore, where he worked in maritime finance, structured asset financing and leasing. The management shake-up comes amid a major fleet renewal programme that has seen Precious sell ageing handysize and supramax vessels while expanding its ultramax fleet. In September, the company returned to China's Taizhou Sanfu Ship Engineering for four 64,500 dwt ultramax newbuildings worth a combined $141.8m, with deliveries scheduled between April 2030 and January 2031. The order followed an earlier $133.46m contract for four 63,500 dwt ultramaxes at the same yard, with two vessels already in service and the remaining pair due through the first quarter of 2027. Once the outstanding newbuildings arrive, Precious expects its fleet to reach 47 vessels totalling about 2.34m dwt. The owner has also started diversifying beyond dry bulk, entering the MR product tanker market earlier this year through direct acquisitions and its 45%-owned Nusantara Maritime joint venture.

泰国 Precious Shipping 准备换帅，长期董事总经理 Khalid Moinuddin Hashim 将转任执行副董事长，财务总监 Gautam Khurana 接手这家曼谷上市干散货船东的日常运营。公司董事会已批准此次人事调整，两项任命均于2027年1月1日生效。Khurana 在继任者任命前将继续担任财务总监，两人均保留董事会与执行董事会席位。Hashim 执掌 Precious 超过三十年，将公司打造成泰国最知名的干散货船东之一（公司成立于1989年，1993年上市）。Khurana 于2018年加入 Precious 担任首席财务官，2019年成为财务总监，此前在伦敦与新加坡的 DVB Bank 从事海事金融工作十年。此次人事变动之际，公司正推进大规模船队更新：出售老旧灵便型与超灵便型船、扩大 Ultramax 船队；9月在台州三福船舶工程再订4艘64,500载重吨 Ultramax 船，合计1.418亿美元，2029年4月至2031年1月交付；此前还有一份1.3346亿美元的4艘63,500载重吨 Ultramax 船合同，其中两艘已投入运营、其余两艘将于2027年第一季度交付。待新船全部交付后，船队将达47艘、约234万载重吨。公司今年还通过直接收购与持股45%的 Nusantara Maritime 合资公司进入 MR 成品油轮市场。

中国跟进美国，将涉美船舶特别港口费暂停延长至2027年1月10日

China Follows US in Continuing Suspension of Fees on Shipping

China's Ministry of Transport confirmed on 9 November that it will extend the suspension of special port fees on US-linked vessels for two months, to 10 January 2027, and continue suspending its shipping and shipbuilding supply-chain investigation. The move reciprocates the USTR's decision to delay its Section 301 vessel fees until January 2027. Beijing also suspended a 24% additional tariff on US imports and extended waivers on certain critical-mineral exports. (Note: published 12:16 ET on 9 November, early morning Singapore time on 10 November.)

中国交通运输部11月9日确认，将针对涉美船舶的特别港口费暂停延长两个月至2027年1月10日，并继续暂停对航运与造船供应链的调查。这是中美第八轮贸易磋商背景下的对等举措，此前美国贸易代表办公室已宣布将301船舶费用暂停延至2027年1月9日（昨日版已刊）。中国同时暂停对美进口加征24%关税，并延长部分关键矿产出口豁免等措施。（注：美东时间11月9日12:16刊发，新加坡时间11月10日凌晨。）

挪威 Havila Shipping 面临银行追讨7,800万美元债务

Banks Step Up Pressure on Havila Shipping Over $78m Debt Dispute

Norwegian offshore vessel owner Havila Shipping is facing renewed enforcement action from three major banks seeking to establish security liens over the company's assets in connection with a long-running debt restructuring dispute. DNB, Swedbank, and Danske Bank have submitted a new request for attachment liens covering NOK779m ($78m), comprising NOK713m in principal and approximately NOK65m in accrued interest. The latest move follows a ruling by Norway's Borgarting Court of Appeal on October 19, which went against Havila in its dispute with the lenders over a restructuring agreement dating back to 2020. Havila has said it disagrees with the judgment and intends to appeal to the Norwegian Supreme Court. The deadline for filing the appeal is November 19. The dispute centres on whether Havila breached the restructuring agreement by refinancing debt owed to lenders that had opted for a cash settlement in December 2024. The three banks, which financed the offshore support vessels Havila Foresight and Havila Harmony, maintain that the refinancing violated the agreement and have since demanded repayment of the outstanding debt. Havila has disputed the lenders' interpretation, arguing that the banks were obliged to convert certain non-interest-bearing debt tranches into shares under the restructuring arrangements. The latest enforcement request does escalate the dispute following the October court ruling, but Havila has not announced any seizure or sale of vessels in connection with the action.

挪威海上船舶船东 Havila Shipping 面临三家主要银行新的强制执行行动，银行要求对其资产设立扣押留置权，涉及长期债务重组纠纷。DNB、瑞典商业银行（Swedbank）与丹麦银行（Danske Bank）提交新的扣押申请，金额7.79亿挪威克朗（7,800万美元），包括本金7.13亿挪威克朗与约6,500万挪威克朗应计利息。此举源于挪威博加廷上诉法院10月19日对 Havila 不利的裁决，争议涉及2020年重组协议；Havila 表示不同意该判决，拟上诉至挪威最高法院，上诉截止日期为11月19日。争议核心是 Havila 是否因在2024年12月对选择现金结算的贷款方进行债务再融资而违反重组协议；三家银行曾为海上支持船 Havila Foresight 与 Havila Harmony 提供融资，认为再融资违反协议并要求偿还未偿债务。Havila 则辩称银行有义务将某些无息债务转为股份。目前尚未宣布与此次行动相关的船舶扣押或出售。
